# teams_meeting_template_permission_policy (Resource)

Manages the MeetingTemplatePermissionPolicy policy via New-CsTeamsMeetingTemplatePermissionPolicy / Get-CsTeamsMeetingTemplatePermissionPolicy / Set-CsTeamsMeetingTemplatePermissionPolicy / Remove-CsTeamsMeetingTemplatePermissionPolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `default_meeting_template_id` (String) Maps to the -DefaultMeetingTemplateId parameter.
- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `hidden_meeting_templates` (String) Maps to the -HiddenMeetingTemplates parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
